families.label: Cross detection and signal correctness
families.rationale: Positional alignment, T-1 timing, and the three-day cross window are covered by correctness tests and the adopted mainline.

families.label: Additional technical-indicator enumeration
families.rationale: RSI, MACD, KDJ, BOLL, MA, ADX/DMI, volume, CMF, BandWidth, and Kaufman ER already cover reversal, trend, location, flow, volatility, and efficiency. Trying more indicators now would be winner selection after repeated tests.

families.label: Indicator periods and score thresholds
families.rationale: Coarse buy, sell, hold, RSI, ADX, ATR, and capacity variants have been tested. Fine searches around the winners are prohibited parameter mining.

families.label: Entry confirmation and backup fills
families.rationale: Volume, trend, weak-entry sizing, low-bounce blocking, backup fills, cross sequence, and gap filters did not produce stable training evidence.

families.label: Signal exits and ATR risk controls
families.rationale: Sell thresholds, minimum holds, structure protection, replacement awareness, profit tightening, cooldowns, and ATR multiplier changes have already been tested.

families.label: Position sizing and idle-capital deployment
families.rationale: Base exposure, volume scaling, weak-signal scaling, strong-trend extra capacity, and forced slot filling have been tested without robust improvement beyond the adopted sizing.

families.label: ETF deletion or selection from training attribution
families.rationale: Deleting ETFs from one training window showed path dependence and selection bias. Pool constituents must not be mined from 2019-2021 standalone contribution.

families.label: Candidate ranking with existing score components
families.rationale: Reversal, location, volume, trend, risk-adjusted, confirmation, and reversal-first rankings were tested; the last apparent gain came from one endpoint trade.

families.label: 09:35 execution gaps and timing filters
families.rationale: The pre-registered one-ATR gap split was sparse and directionally contradicted the chase-risk hypothesis. Smaller thresholds must not be searched post hoc.

families.label: Portfolio-level dependence and crowding
families.rationale: The single pre-registered 20-day/0.80 observation produced only 9 high-dependence trades. High dependence was profitable overall and strongly outperformed low dependence in 2020, so it is not a stable crowding filter. Do not search nearby windows or thresholds.

families.label: ETF-pool breadth regime
families.rationale: The single pre-registered MA20/50% observation reversed across years. Below-majority mild-trend entries had higher win rate in 2020 and materially better return and win rate in 2021, so breadth is not a stable universal entry filter.

families.label: ETF premium, quota, tracking, and cross-market microstructure
families.rationale: The one pre-registered 513100/513500 previous-NAV premium attribution found only two above-5% closed buys, both in 2020 and both in 513100. Sample-size, cross-year, and cross-code gates failed, so lower thresholds or wider QDII scopes are prohibited post-hoc searches.

families.label: User-authorized QDII underlying-index direction observation
families.rationale: The four locked 2018-2021 raw value series have been staged and hashed, but SPX and H30533 still lack approved historical final-value availability policies. The formal root remains absent. The observation cannot run and no candidate may be created until every file passes the 09:35 availability, finality, source, calendar, and boundary contract.

families.label: User-authorized fixed MACD half-cycle comparison
families.rationale: The one fixed MACD(6,13,5) comparison was consumed. It cut local training return from 120.61% to 84.69% and worsened Sharpe, Sortino, win rate, profit/loss ratio, 2019, and 2021. Nearby period searches are prohibited.

families.label: User-authorized fixed cross-window comparison
families.rationale: The fixed cross_window=1/2/3/4 matrix was consumed. Official window 3 had the highest total and annualized return, lowest drawdown, and strongest Sharpe, Sortino, and profit/loss ratio. Windows 1, 2, and 4 all failed the pre-registered gate. Wider, per-indicator, or age-weighted window searches are prohibited.

families.label: User-authorized fixed execution-time comparison
families.rationale: The fixed 09:35 versus 10:00 comparison was consumed. Although 10:00 improved aggregate return, drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, and win rate locally, it worsened 2021 return and profit/loss ratio. Matched execution prices also failed the pre-registered annual and non-QDII consistency gates. Retain 09:35 and prohibit searches over nearby times, intraday windows, ETF-specific times, or timing interactions.

families.label: User-authorized horizontal support and resistance structure
families.rationale: The fixed prior-20-day T-2-safe, one-ATR observation failed its annual gate. Near-resistance mild entries outperformed the comparison in 2019 and had higher win rate in 2021; all 89 closed buys were more than one ATR above prior support. Nearby periods, distances, pivots, and breakout rules are prohibited post-hoc searches.

families.label: User-authorized controlled-breakout anti-chase check
families.rationale: The one fixed observation found 15 controlled breakouts but only 2 extended breakouts: one in 2019, none in 2020, and one in 2021. The total and per-year sample gates failed, and the 2019 extended trade had a higher win rate than controlled breakouts. No candidate was permitted; nearby thresholds, periods, AND variants, breakout rewards, and sell changes are prohibited post-hoc searches.

families.label: User-authorized ETF shares-outstanding shadow diagnostic
families.rationale: The one fixed five-observation sign-only attribution had complete coverage for all 52 eligible domestic closed buys, but its relationship reversed by year. Non-positive flow had higher average return in 2019 and 2020, while positive flow had higher average return and win rate in 2021; neither group dominated both metrics in every year. No candidate was permitted, and nearby periods, thresholds, magnitude buckets, fund-size/NAV interactions, QDII extensions, or sell rules are prohibited post hoc.

families.label: User-authorized ordinary-buy minute execution overlay
families.rationale: The one fixed ordinary-buy execution overlay matched all 92 eligible training orders and improved aggregate arrival cost by about 2.63 basis points, but its 2020 average was about 0.78 basis point worse. The pre-registered every-year gate failed, so no portfolio candidate was permitted and nearby times, cycle counts, prices, fallback rules, ETF exceptions, or sell overlays are prohibited post hoc.
families.gate_reason: 2020 average execution price does not improve

families.label: User-authorized same-side contraction and re-expansion observation
families.rationale: The fixed same-side re-expansion observation failed its five-day aggregate and annual consistency gate in both directions. Bullish novel events returned less with lower win rate than active true crosses overall, weakened in 2020, and were negative in 2021. Bearish novel events were followed by positive returns overall and did not improve directional accuracy. No score or order candidate was permitted.

families.label: User-authorized fixed one-entry-ATR break-even candidate
families.rationale: The single fixed candidate activated a cost floor only after the stored closing-price peak reached one entry ATR. It reduced local training return from 120.61% to 114.28%, worsened drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, win rate, profit/loss ratio, 2020, and 2021, so it was rejected before JoinQuant or validation. Nearby activation levels, profit floors, staged stops, or ETF/year exceptions are prohibited post hoc.

families.label: User-authorized fixed MACD-free and KDJ-only exit candidate
families.rationale: The single fixed candidate retained MACD only for observation, removed its score points, and used the standard K/D death cross as the sole ordinary exit after the frozen five-trading-day minimum hold. It cut local training return from 120.61% to 41.87%, worsened every aggregate metric and every annual return, and increased buys from 92 to 170. The candidate was rejected before JoinQuant or validation; nearby decompositions and parameter variants are prohibited post hoc.

families.label: User-authorized fixed MACD death-cross fast-exit candidate
families.rationale: The single fixed candidate kept all official buy and sell paths but added a recent MACD death-cross OR exit after the five-day hold. It cut local training return from 120.61% to 81.75%, worsened every aggregate metric and all three annual returns, and increased buys from 92 to 128. It was rejected before JoinQuant or validation; nearby variants are prohibited post hoc.

families.label: User-authorized fixed KDJ-only ordinary-exit candidate
families.rationale: The single fixed candidate preserved the complete official buy path, including MACD scoring, but used the recent K/D death cross as the sole ordinary exit after five trading days. It cut local training return from 120.61% to 42.64%, worsened every aggregate metric and all three annual returns, and increased buys from 92 to 170. It was rejected before JoinQuant or validation; nearby KDJ/hold/window variants are prohibited post hoc.

families.label: User-authorized fixed profit-tiered ATR tightening
families.rationale: The single fixed variant was consumed. Step 0 found 36 binding stop-check events (4/24/8 in 2019/2020/2021) but zero days where the tightened stop triggered while the baseline stop did not. The Step 1 local A/B therefore changed 0 filled orders and every metric was identical to the cross-v0.3.3 baseline, so the 'at least 3 filled orders change' gate failed and the candidate was rejected before JoinQuant or validation. The cross-signal 5% stop floor plus frozen entry ATR makes the multi-factor V2.6 profit-tier mechanism a no-op here. Nearby tier thresholds, multiplier factors, peak-profit measurements, profit floors, and per-ETF overrides are prohibited post hoc.

families.label: User-authorized fixed gold-specific stop parameters
families.rationale: The single fixed variant was consumed. Step 0 found 223 binding gold stop-check days and 6 same-day extra triggers, but the Step 1 local A/B failed the gates: total return +125.00% to +120.96%, max drawdown 6.03% to 6.08%, Sharpe and Sortino worse, and 2019/2021 annual returns worse. The first extra stop clipped a 2019 winner (+4.7% exit versus +9.0% baseline exit) and cascaded into 162 changed fills. The multi-factor V2.8 gold stop does not transfer to this framework's reversal-entry path. No nearby gold floor or multiplier values and no per-ETF extension are allowed.

families.label: User-authorized fixed profit-giveback direct exit
families.rationale: The single fixed variant was consumed. The Step 0 trade-level counterfactual found 79 firing events across 21 affected closed trades, but the total per-share delta was -0.352 and the annual deltas were -0.380/-0.101/+0.129 in 2019/2020/2021, failing the total and annual gates. The rule would have clipped two major winners (2019-02-11 159928: rule exit 2.245 vs official 2.666; 2020-04-17 513050: 1.523 vs 1.927) while saving small amounts on other trades. Large trend winners routinely give back more than 3pp mid-hold, so a profit-giveback exit kills the payoff source of this framework. No candidate was created; no threshold or mechanism search is allowed.

families.label: User-authorized fixed intraday-high trailing anchor
families.rationale: The single fixed variant was consumed. Step 0 found 1604 binding stop-check days and 38 same-day extra triggers, but the Step 1 local A/B failed the gates: total return +125.00% to +119.40%, max drawdown 6.03% to 6.06%, and 2019 annual return +35.84% to +30.55%. The dominant clip was 2019-02-11 159928 (exit 2.232 versus official 2.666, -0.434 per share on an +18.8% winner); seven small saves could not offset it (total per-share delta -0.228). The peak-day upper wick raises the high anchor into the winner's normal pullback band, turning the noise the close anchor was designed to filter back into stop triggers. No anchor blends, multiplier re-calibrations, or threshold searches are allowed.

families.label: User-authorized fixed profit-gated direct-sell matrix
families.rationale: The fixed 4x3 matrix was consumed. All 12 variants failed the Step 0 trade-level gates: the 38/40 score thresholds never fired (sell scores that high arrive only after profit has already left the 2-6% band), and the 32/35 thresholds produced negative total per-share deltas because the 513050 +34% winner's mid-hold pullback satisfies high-score plus small-profit conditions and would be exited early. The pre-registered selection rule found no passing variant, so no candidate was created. No nearby thresholds, bands, or mechanism variants may be searched.

families.label: User-authorized fixed bullish-cross age-2 half-decay candidate
families.rationale: The single frozen age-2 multiplier 0.5 changed 64 filled-order days across all three training years but cut local return from +125.00% to +87.35%, worsened maximum drawdown from 6.03% to 8.79%, worsened Sharpe, Sortino, profit/loss ratio, and every annual return. The candidate was rejected before JoinQuant or validation. Other decay coefficients, per-indicator age weights, exceptions, and compensating rules are prohibited post hoc.

families.label: User-authorized fixed 14:45 point-in-time signal pass
families.rationale: The user explicitly authorized one new structural family: preserve the official 09:35 decision and add one causal 14:45 full signal pass from completed minutes through 14:44. This is not a search over execution times or indicator rules.

families.label: User-authorized fixed fresh-unextended fast-entry candidate
families.rationale: The single frozen earlier-entry candidate was rejected by the official JoinQuant 2019-2021 run. It reduced total return from 129.25% to 111.14%, win rate from 55.8% to 49.0%, profit/loss ratio from 5.297 to 3.904, increased positive-to-negative round trips from 31 to 39, and left drawdown effectively unchanged at 6.29% versus 6.28%. The added channel closed only 4 winners against 15 losers; no neighboring score, age, ATR, or ETF rule may be searched.

families.label: User-authorized late-MACD BOLL-upper new-buy filter
families.rationale: The fixed read-only observation found only 2 matches among 98 official filled buys, both in 2019, and failed the pre-registered 3-event/2-year gate. The user nevertheless authorized the exact standalone veto. Its official JoinQuant run left win rate unchanged at 55.8% and reduced total return, annual return, profit/loss ratio, Sharpe, Sortino, and information ratio, so it failed the accuracy gate and was rejected. The isolated candidate is retained only as the base for the separately authorized stacked test; no nearby veto rule may be searched.

families.label: User-authorized stacked late veto and early pre-MACD entry
families.rationale: The completed 2019-2021 JoinQuant run recorded 20 direct early-channel buys but reduced total return, win rate, and payoff quality while worsening maximum drawdown versus both the formal strategy and the standalone late-veto candidate. Because the candidate stacked two changes, the result cannot assign all damage to the early channel alone; it does prove that this exact 50-59, age-at-most-one, negative-and-narrowing-MACD stack is not acceptable. No neighboring score, age, MACD, BOLL, RSI, ETF, queue, or sell variant is allowed.

families.label: User-authorized T-1 price-reversal pre-MACD leftover entry
families.rationale: The exact causal price-reversal rule produced 26 direct fills across all three training years, so it was materially testable, but 25 closed direct entries contained only 8 wins and 17 losses. One +35.04% 513050 trade made direct realized PnL positive while the completed portfolio path lost 54.58 percentage points of total return and 8.71 percentage points of win rate versus official. Doubled friction worsened the failure. No threshold, magnitude, trend-score, nearby pattern, ETF, year, score, or sell variant is permitted.

families.label: User-authorized full-capacity opportunity-cost replacement
families.rationale: The fixed rule required all three holdings to complete five sessions, a complete official score-at-least-60 buy candidate, and an existing sell-score-at-least-30 holding blocked only by price confirmation or ADX protection. Nineteen local replacements reduced win rate, return, drawdown quality, Sharpe, Sortino, profit/loss ratio, and every annual return. No JoinQuant or PTrade candidate was generated; do not search nearby thresholds, score spreads, ETF exceptions, rankings, hold periods, or cooldowns.

families.label: User-authorized unified KDJ extreme-zone score bonus
families.rationale: The fixed K<=20 buy +5 and K>=80 sell +5 rule changed zero filled orders. No buy snapshot crossed 60; eleven sell snapshots crossed 30 but all remained blocked by official price/ADX protections. Accuracy and every metric were identical, so no JoinQuant or PTrade candidate was generated. Historical point-in-time IOPV was unavailable and the live-only override was not tested.

families.label: User-authorized tiered three-session KDJ state bonus
families.rationale: The one fixed tiered-persistence rule changed 22 filled-order days but reduced win rate, return, Sharpe, Sortino, profit/loss ratio, and doubled-friction quality. It produced no changed order day in 2021 and failed the frozen accuracy-first gate, so no JoinQuant or PTrade candidate was generated. Do not search nearby points, zones, retention lengths, direction rules, or protection overrides.
